instructions: Classify the overall aerial scene in the image into exactly one of the supplied AID scene classes. Select the class that best describes the scene as a whole, rather than every object visible. Use only the image.
image_policy: All controls and transformed variants are 600x600 RGB lossless PNG; control preserves decoded RGB pixels; no resizing.
scoring: Failed requests count as incorrect; same 30-way choice validation as original eval

transform_protocol.selection: 10 per class from test, lowest SHA256(seed+filename); independent of predictions
transform_protocol.image_policy: All controls and transformed variants are 600x600 RGB lossless PNG; control preserves decoded RGB pixels; no resizing.

transformations.shift: 60 pixels left/right with reflected fill; crops 60 original boundary pixels, so this is not pure object-position isolation

transform_protocol.analysis: Paired accuracy changes vs fresh control; McNemar tests; pairwise differences of change via paired randomization; Holm across 30 within-model and 60 between-model tests.
notes: Equal-class balanced subset; accuracy is not directly comparable to the full test split.
Ground truth held fixed; stronger transforms may remove discriminative evidence.
Single stochastic response per model/image/condition; repeat on independent data to confirm.
